briefings.title: Extended Interview: Tom Llamas sits down with Secretary of State Marco Rubio
briefings.tldr: Secretary of State Marco Rubio, attending the Trump-Xi Summit in Beijing, emphasized a "strategic stability" approach to China that combines direct diplomatic engagement with a rigorous domestic policy of re-industrialization to reduce reliance on Chinese supply chains.

briefings.title: Top Story with Tom Llamas - May 14 | NBC News NOW
briefings.tldr: President Trump and President Xi’s high-stakes Beijing summit yielded pledges from China to assist in reopening the Strait of Hormuz and a major Boeing aircraft deal, while the U.S. simultaneously engaged in critical "aid diplomacy" with a crisis-stricken Cuba.

briefings.title: Full interview: Tom Llamas exclusive with President Trump
briefings.tldr: President Donald Trump asserts that the U.S. has reached a 125-year low in crime and record economic growth under his leadership, while outlining plans for domestic "crime cleanup" in major cities, AI dominance, and a potential 2028 Republican ticket featuring JD Vance and Marco Rubio.

briefings.title: Extended interview: Tom Llamas exclusive with President Trump
briefings.tldr: President Trump discussed his administration's strong stance on immigration enforcement, claiming success in lowering crime rates nationwide and on the border, while also outlining his economic policies including tariffs and potential rebate checks, and his views on AI's impact, election integrity, and global relations.

briefings.title: President Trump talks Minneapolis, Joe Rogan, the Fed, AI and 2028 in a wide-ranging interview
briefings.tldr: President Trump discussed evolving law enforcement strategies in Minneapolis, emphasized national election integrity with mandatory voter identification, speculated on a strong 2028 ticket featuring JD Vance and Marco Rubio, and reiterated a firm stance against Iran's nuclear ambitions.
